verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a SaaS platform with an admin API surface, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive or try-it API reference with runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the automation and webhooks docs are adjacent features, not an interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
